summary: On node1, created the datauser account and a dedicated XFS-backed loopback filesystem mounted at /srv/data (via /etc/fstab, options loop,pquota,prjquota). Set an XFS project quota hard limit of 100MB for datauser's project on /srv/data. Filesystem-level enforcement was verified both before and after a full node reboot: writes past 100MB fail with "No space left on device" and xfs_quota reports the 100M hard limit. Boot identity changed across the restart (boot_id 6aa805ba... -> d3dd7dfe...), and the mount, ownership, and quota all recovered automatically on boot.
actions_performed: Installed quota and xfsprogs packages on node1
Added /etc/fstab entry mounting the image at /srv/data with loop,pquota,prjquota options
Registered datauser as an XFS project (projid 1001) scoped to /srv/data via /etc/projid and /etc/projects
Set XFS project quota hard limit bhard=100m for datauser on /srv/data
Verified enforcement pre-reboot: writes stopped exactly at 100MB with ENOSPC, quota report matched, cleanup returned usage to 0
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, mount, quota report)
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, polled until reachable again
Confirmed changed boot_id proving a real restart occurred
Re-verified post-restart: /srv/data auto-mounted with prjquota, quota limit intact, and a 150MB write attempt was capped at exactly 100MB with ENOSPC

evidence.summary: useradd created datauser (uid 1000); ls -ld /srv/data shows datauser:datauser ownership

evidence.requirement: /srv/data is a filesystem-enforced 100MB quota for datauser
evidence.summary: xfs_quota project setup and limit -p bhard=100m; quota report shows datauser hard=100M

evidence.requirement: quota is actually enforced by the filesystem (not just configured)
evidence.summary: dd writes stopped exactly at 100MB total with 'No space left on device'; quota report confirmed 100M used
umount/mount cycle via fstab entry, /srv/data remounted with prjquota, quota report intact
Captured boot_id 6aa805ba..., mount state, quota report, ownership, and datauser id prior to reboot
systemctl reboot issued on node1; command stream ended as the node went down, confirming the reboot was actioned

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving real restart
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot (timeouts), then became reachable again with new boot_id d3dd7dfe-bd68-4c28-a141-928ff914b32e, differing from pre-restart 6aa805ba...

evidence.requirement: post-restart recovery of quota-enforced mount and data
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: /srv/data auto-mounted with prjquota via fstab, ownership and quota project intact, 150MB write attempt capped at exactly 100MB with ENOSPC, cleanup returned usage to 0
